hypothesis: Buying liquid active common stocks at the next regular-session open after a session whose tape was dominated by abnormally large average trade size (per-trade dollar size z-score at least 3 versus the stock's own trailing 126-session distribution, with dollar volume at or above its trailing-20 median and close at or above open) produces positive after-cost H10 replacement value versus zero-return cash and above same-interval SPY and QQQ holds, because block-dominated absorption reveals institutional accumulation that diffuses into price over roughly ten sessions and the per-trade size field is not consumed by standard OHLCV screens.

provenance.baseline_policy: zero-return cash is the primary per-row comparator; SPY and QQQ identical next-open-to-H10 costed holds are secondary comparators, and the aggregate must also exceed both secondary aggregates for the lead to survive

independent_evidence.decision_exclusions: All bars with trade_date after the signal date, every forward return or outcome field, and any vendor field other than open, close, volume, vwap and transactions are forbidden selection inputs.
descriptive fields, FIGIs, current reference rows and future vendor revisions

expectation_gap.gap_definition: Standard OHLCV screens price volume and range but not the number of prints behind the volume; an extreme per-trade dollar size outlier on confirming volume with non-negative intraday pressure is independent microstructure evidence of block-dominated absorption that the price-and-volume-only market prior does not separately represent.

transmission.catalyst: A session whose dollar volume arrives in abnormally large per-trade prints (average trade size z >= 3 versus the stock's own trailing 126-session distribution) with dollar volume at or above the trailing-20 median and close >= open.
transmission.expected_direction: Selected block-print absorption sessions should show positive aggregate after-cost H10 replacement value versus cash and exceed identical-interval SPY and QQQ holds.
transmission.half_life: Next regular-session open through the tenth subsequent trading-session close.

why_not_arbitraged: Per-trade size aggregates are absent from common free OHLCV feeds, block-dominated sessions are heterogeneous (buybacks, repositioning, index events) so the naive version may fail after costs, modern order-splitting weakens the classic block-signal and deters casual use, most of the 627 issuers sit outside megacap coverage, and the roster must clear round-trip costs plus SPY/QQQ hurdles rather than merely show a positive raw drift.
falsifier: Reject the research lead unless the frozen 725-row roster stays exactly 241/242/242 across old_third/mid_third/late_third, at least two of three chronological windows and the aggregate have strictly positive after-cost replacement value versus cash, the aggregate treatment value also exceeds the identical-interval SPY and QQQ aggregate values, the double-cost aggregate remains positive, the maximum single-ticker positive contribution is at most 40%, the top-five positive contribution share is at most 60%, and contribution HHI is at most 0.25. Report an overlapping-hold cluster block bootstrap interval descriptively; if it includes zero, any positive result remains an unstable observed-only descriptive lead. Any evidence that transactions or vwap aggregates were revised after the simulated decision, or any post-signal field entering selection, invalidates the frozen scout rather than permitting a retune.

baseline.policy: Every roster row is compared to zero-return cash at identical $4,000 notional and identical costed interval; SPY and QQQ next-open-to-H10 identical costed holds are computed per row and aggregated as secondary hurdles. No core slot is consumed and no paper or live capital is claimed.

treatment.policy: For each signal date, require membership in the latest complete Massive reference-asof active common-stock snapshot no later than the signal date, at least 126 prior populated bars, trailing-20 median dollar volume at least $1,000,000, and close at least $3. Signal: average dollar trade size (vwap*volume/transactions) z-score at least 3.0 versus the stock's own trailing 126-session baseline, signal-day dollar volume at or above the trailing-20 median, and close at or above open. Rank by descending z, select at most two per signal date with a 10-session per-ticker cooldown, de-duplicate to one ticker-date decision. Enter each of the frozen 725 rows at the next regular-session open, exit at the tenth session close counting entry, apply repository round-trip costs on a fixed $4,000 research notional, and report double-cost stress. All post-signal bars and outcomes are forbidden selection inputs.

replacement_value_comparator: Zero-return cash is the primary per-row hurdle at identical notional and costs; SPY and QQQ identical-interval costed holds are secondary aggregate hurdles that the treatment aggregate must also exceed. No core slot map is consumed.

execution_envelope.borrow_dependency: None; the treatment is long-only and cannot create a short.
execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: At most two selections per signal date at a fixed $4,000 research notional each; no paper or live capital claim is permitted.
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: Use the repository round-trip cost percentage and a predeclared double-cost stress; no financing credit or borrow benefit is assumed.
execution_envelope.intended_instrument: Cash equities exactly as identified by the dated Massive ticker; no ETF, option, leverage or present-day identity remapping.
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: Trailing-20 median dollar volume at least $1,000,000 and close at least $3 at the signal date; research entry requires a valid next-session open.
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: The signal uses only session-close fields known by the signal-date New York close; entry is the next regular-session open and exit is the fixed tenth-session close.
